2. Practice creating a feeling of confidence and gratitude about having what
you want. You are combining several of the previous sessions into one. Desire for what
you want, and at the same time gratitude for having it. Confidence that it will happen.
Excitement for making the expressions, and taking the actions to create and have the
what you want.

3. Practice getting connected with the power of your personal will. From that
state of power direct your energy into action that will build the new dream of
what you want.

4. By practicing these two exercises, and later combining them, you will shift
your perspective into the viewpoint of a new sense of self. We might call that
new character role the Artist or Creator of your life. You are no longer playing as
a character in your unconscious, but as the conscious writer and director of your own life
play. You are consciously choosing your roles, and creating with force and power that you
recovered from the beliefs and emotions previously stored in your characters. It may be
uncomfortable, or unfamiliar, but it is worth getting past that and learning to be
comfortable in your new Creator role.



Some notes

Building a new dream is about attachment. It’s how you build the new house we
mentioned in the gratitude exercise 1. You have added to the new house with some of the
exercises like gratitude, Acceptance, Silent mind meditations and prayer. At this stage we
take it further into action in the world outside.

Desire, Faith, Gratitude and Confidence of a New Dream

Breaking the process down into smaller parts may be more helpful.

You may have several things you want, or several different lists. You may best be served
by doing this exercise multiple times with smaller parts of your list. For instance, maybe
you do one faith, confidence, gratitude, and desire meditation on what you want in





                                                                                                               1/2

relationships. Then do it again later focusing just what you want for career. Do the process
again for what you want for finances. etc.

Make this process about how you want to express yourself. As you practice how you want
to express yourself that feels good and build on what you want to create and live as your
life.

By imagining having the life you want you are training your brain and nervous system to
be in the state to already be there. By doing this you are building an internal map of a
belief system. You are programming your belief system to guide you to express that world
externally.

Willpower and Action process

The standing exercise about getting in touch with your will is meant to give you a
confidence and power feeling in your body. It is about connecting with an energy center.
With practice, you get in touch with that sense of power, and direct that power through
your body towards an action that helps create what you want in your life.

It may take practice to connect you to that force moving through your body.

The same focus that you used to relax your body in the Acceptance exercise is now being
used to focus towards movement. You may also find that breathing into your will helps
connect you to that sense of force in your body.





                                                                                                               2/2

title: Module 24-Build a New Dream-24- SM - Build A New Dream - 02 Obstacles you are likely to find
method: Text extracted from the original written course handout.

pages.text:
Obstacles you are likely to find

    selfmastery.mn.co/posts/self-mastery-course-ii-obstacles-you-are-likely-to-find-6431694

Balance with your Skeptic character

If you have effectively been working the program exercises to this point, you have
developed a strong skeptic character. It is an automated program at this point that
watches your thoughts and questions them without you having to consciously try.

You have created a new Skeptic character over the past several months. Congratulations.
Now it is time to give him a rest. You need to put your skeptic on pause about your new
dream in order to believe in your new dream enough to take action on it.

Your skeptical observer was a necessary step out of your old house, but if you remain on
that step, you are held back from the next phase of your life. To go further up the ladder at
you need to let go of the rung that brought you to the level where you are. Continue to use
your Skeptic on your old house of beliefs, but refrain from applying him to the new dream.
If he works on the new dream that way he will be a saboteur.

Comfortable with Responsibility

One of the resistance modes that comes up is that there can be discomfort in being
responsible. You may have learned when you were young, and then unconsciously
practiced not being responsible. Whenever people look to blame or find fault they ask
"Who is responsible?" We learned that if we are not responsible then we will not get
blamed, we will not get punished, and we will not feel guilt and shame.

Therefore it can be safer emotionally in that belief bubble to hypnotize ourselves to be a
powerless victim. This is a bubble of illusion. It is merely a story about how we can avoid
the blame, shame, and guilt. This old story is the way the victim wants to operate. “go
along with others, or go along with what the Judge says to do.” Don’t create anything for
yourself, so you don’t fail. If it fails others will blame you and the judge will punish you so
don’t take any responsibility and don’t create anything of your own." That’s how to avoid
fault and blame according to painful lies.

If you are honest at how tiny and suffocating this prison of stories the victim wants to live
in, and the fear the walls are made with, it will become unpalatable. This is not safety in
any way. It is emotional hell of fear, but you may have beliefs that say it is "better". You
will not be able to digest those lies and emotions with any part of your Integrity. If you
look with awareness you will see that this victim isn’t safe at all. It is still living in the
painful punishments as it fears them.

The solution here is to get in touch with the emotions of fear and pain and work them out
with the Releasing Emotions or Recapitulation or Inventory process.





                                                                                                               1/2

title: Module 24-Build a New Dream-24- SM - Build A New Dream - 03 Common Questions
method: Text extracted from the original written course handout.

pages.text:
Common Questions

   selfmastery.mn.co/posts/self-mastery-course-ii-common-questions-6431696

How long will it take to create the life you want?

Some things may happen right away. Some things on the list of what you want may or
may not happen in your life. It might be that some of what you want is desired by the ego.
If that is the case, it may take longer and might not happen.

Those things aligned with your integrity and Truth will be created the fastest. Those
things may also take time depending on how big they are.

One thing I’ve discovered, is that things can happen fast. Given that physicists and
scientists can not prove the existence of time, amazing things can happen in no time at
all.

There is a window of creation in which time does not exist. So, no one really knows how
long anything takes.



Is this like using the law of attraction?

Yes, except with some differences. Since I have not studied the law of attraction stuff first
hand, but came about manifesting life desires in a different approach, I can’t speak to all
of it’s elements.

From what I understand, most law of attraction processes fail to address the sabotaging
elements of unconscious beliefs and characters. Without addressing these beliefs and
emotions, you have little chance of creating a new life. Your unconscious beliefs will
simply sabotage conscious efforts and intentions.

All the processes in the Self Mastery approach address these sabotaging ego beliefs either
directly, or in the sections on Resistance in each lesson.



What if I don't feel my "will" in the exercise?

This may be a process. It depends on how cut off you have been from feeling that force,
and movement in your body. Of course several of the previous exercises will help. The
Breathing and Silent Mind work in session 14, and Acceptance from session 6 are ways to
connect. Also the session on Releasing Emotions helps to put you in touch with feeling
the energy in your body.

If you practice those exercises it will help you get in touch with feelings inside.




                                                                                                               1/2

Are there any limits to what I want to create?

I don’t think so. I don’t know what the limits of possibility are. I’d rather come up with
something outlandishly beautiful and go for it, than live in fear and doubt and never try
because of ideas of limitations that might be lies.

Since I don’t know the boundaries of reality and creation I can not put limits on
possibility. I think that would be arrogant.

I am personally curious and keep exploring possibility. My current project is building this
new community and training teachers. It's probably a 5 to 10 year project.





                                                                                                               2/2

Lesson Transcript

    selfmastery.mn.co/posts/self-mastery-course-ii-lesson-transcript-6588444

Hello this is Gary van Warmerdam with the advanced series on the pathway to happiness
and this is a session about manifesting what you want, session that is a lot. Why I put it in
one session I don’t know. Partly because it all belongs in one place. I’m going to believe
that I can put enough here to make it clear. First of all understand about manifesting what
you want goes very much against everything you learnt in the first course and some of the
things in the first couple of sessions in this advance program. What we learnt in the first
course, what we learnt in the few sessions about judgment was all about detaching by
moving into an observer’s point of view and not believing a story, not even believing your
own identity in your self-image.

That not believing dynamic has a very powerful impact in that it then doesn’t feed the
dream, it doesn’t feed the behavior, it doesn’t feed the story and in doing so that story,
that behavior, that motivation falls apart. It’s a process of detachment. Detachment is how
you let go of the old dream. If you’ve been spending several months doing this or you’ve
been doing this program for a year or more and then got to the session, you may have
become very skilled at detaching and letting go of all these beliefs and this is a fantastic
skill, it’s a marvelous tool to use, however at a certain point you need to drop that tool.
You’re no longer in the sledgehammer mode of leveling the foundation.

You’re now in a building phase and so that very valuable skill of detachment that you use
to get yourself free from drama, habits, behaviors, addictions now becomes deadweight
because when it’s time to create new the dream you want you need to put that tool aside
or else you are going to start destroying just by automatic habit and detachment the very
dream you’re working to build, the dream of what you do want to recognize that this is
very much a shifting gears and don’t apply those detachment mechanisms and tools of not
believing to this new dream of what you want.

At first it might be a habit but you are going to have to hunt down that subtlety where
those I don’t believe the story patterns that we’ve created through these exercises start
applying themselves to what you do what. You need to hunt that down and kind of go wait
a minute, wait a minute that’s not where I want to play it. This isn’t the dream I would
apply it to. So that’s first heads up on being careful of what not to do.

In creating what we want there are about four elements that need to come into play, that
we need to bring together. One of them is desire, the other’s faith which is the belief that it
can happen, you can have that dream and you can create it, so there’s a belief in yourself
and a belief in the dream of your life. Understand when I talk about the dream of your life
I’m talking about the emotional quality you want to live in. I’m talking about the kinds of
relationships you have, even financial and physical matters and the types of things you
want to be doing and traveling. So it has a physical element, it has emotional element, it
has a spiritual element whatever aspect of your life is what I call you dream of your life





                                                                                                               1/9

right down to what kind of thoughts do you want running through your head. So there’s a
desire, there’s the belief which we will call faith. Faith is believing a 100% which means no
doubt, no fear.

The third thing you need is action. Action comes from, from willpower. This force you
have to actually express and take action on something. Desire, faith, action. Requirements
for action are willpower, accessing that force that drives you forward. If you are so busy in
so many areas of your life that you’re expending all your willpower all your energy on your
existing situation, you don’t have any extra energy or willpower to create something new,
in that regard then it’s time to check some things off your list or dissolve some things so
you have some more personal power to direct in this new area.

I want to say that we covered desire when we started to address what you want. In that
exercise, I asked you specifically to dream up what you want your life to be like, what you
want specifically your practice life to be like and I asked you specifically to connect an
emotional quality. What is the state of enjoyment, happiness, love, passion, excitement,
pleasure that is connected to doing those activities and those expressions and specifically
I asked you, make it about how you want to express yourself because that’s a much more
intrinsic emotional sensation than having something because having something you can
decide to have gratitude about it, you can decide to love it or decide not to but in that
expression you are in the expression of life and it’s much more powerful.

The sensations we feel when we are authentically expressing ourselves are enjoyable, they
are pleasureful and so when you recognize that you will instinctively desire to make those
expressions, whether it’s service and love to people, whether it’s creating as an artist,
whether it’s singing those expressions are the enjoyment part, being in action at the
enjoyment part. So if you did that exercise then we should’ve taken care of the desire part.
There should already be a desire to really enjoy your life. It’s that emotional association
that will create the motivation and desire, desire for pleasure and enjoyment in life,
provided you have your basic, material, physical needs taken care of.

So that takes care of the desire, then we just have to do willpower, action and faith. Action
was the last item in that exercise about what you want in terms of making out a list of
action items that will get you what you want. It may be a whole laundry list, it may be new
degrees. Whatever it is there’s a whole lot of intermediate steps in between where you are
now and what you want to create. Those are the action items but that doesn’t inspire us to
take action, the desired does. The thing you have to understand about these action items
is once you have them there on the list there is no more need to contemplate, regurgitate
the thinking of, reconsider, you don’t have to make decisions about what you’re going to
do. It’s right there in front of you and there’s hardly much to do in terms of what to do
first, what to do second. The order isn’t that important. All of that kind of contemplation
keeps yourself in your head and when it comes to creating, believe it or not that’s
something we do not want to do, you do not want to be in your head.

You may need to engage your mind but more important that you engage your will. When I
decided to build a website and finally decided I was going to do it myself, I was like okay I
had to go learn website design, I need to go learn something about one of these programs



                                                                                                               2/9

that designs and creates websites and all the stuff and once I decided that and I created
the motivation and the desire to do it I went off to the bookstore and then I engaged my
mind in the activity of absorbing all these information, taking that tutorial book and
opening up the pages and doing the tutorial program on my computer, doing all the
practice sessions with the practice website they had included in it.

So I engaged my mind as a function of my will. I get things done by action and use my
mind as a tool for that action. Most people make the mistake of they engage their mind as
the force that drives it and that doesn’t work. You need to engage your will which is a
different kind of energetic expression. If you go back to listen to and remember, the
exercise on acceptance, what I had you do was shift the state of your body and relax into
your body by shifting your attention. I had you put your attention and all the muscles in
your body what it felt like and from there you could relax your state. That is not
something that you could do mentally. That’s what I’m pointing to when I talk about
willpower and action and shifting out of your mind and more into your body.

There’s a couple things you need to consider when we going to action. What we are really
doing is putting ourselves in a state where we are not dominated by thinking. We’re going
to use our mind is a tool but it’s not the one driving the show. We aren’t contemplating am
I doing the right thing or not right thing. Should I be doing this or should I be doing that?
Those questions are not at play so there’s not that much to think about in terms of the
direction we’re going. Then there is no room in that contemplation for doubt. You say if I
should be doing this or should be doing that? Now we are questioning ourselves and there
is an opportunity to doubt in that thinking and that’s why we want to stay out of a real
dominant thinking and stay more in a feeling state.

In the feeling state we can create an attitude, that attitude is of confidence that I can do it
and it will be done which is an attitude of no doubt and no fear. So it’s an emotional state,
it’s an attitude state, it’s a confident state. When you’re in that state you start to
instinctively take action based on your intrinsic desire. You start expressing yourself in
the direction of what you want and how you want to create and the actions you want to
take. In this exercise, I will give you two tools, two ways to kind of access that state, that
confident attitude without doubt, without fear. I am going to give them to you individually
and ones about willpower and action. The second one is about faith, putting yourself in a
state of no doubt.

You can practice them each individually and later on when you get comfortable and you
get skillful at each one, what you can then advance to is combining them, merging them
together to put yourself in a powerful state of accessing your will while at a state of faith
and now we’re doubling our intent and our focus to go get things done.

The first state I want to put you into is about faith and how we are going to do that is we
are going to build on two sessions you’ve done previously. One is the gratitude session and
one is the emotional mastery session. We are going to merge that with that list of what
you want to create in your life. So to get yourself in that state that things are possible, to





                                                                                                               3/9

believe that your dream is possible and that you can do it, close your eyes provided you’re
not driving in a car. I always say close your eyes in this so that you can more effectively
focus your attention without distraction.

Put your attention in your lungs and why I always use the lungs why it’s a good idea is that
it helps you to be present in the moment right now which takes you out of past and future
thinking, to hear the tricks and here’s where the tricks work.

So close your eyes. Feel the breath in your lungs, force of life in each breath and put
yourself in a state of gratitude, gratitude perhaps just for the breath, gratitude for no
reason if you’ve develop the skill to that level. Gratitude for whatever is in your life, people
you love. Whatever mechanism you want to use, need to use to put yourself in a state of
gratitude to where you are breathing in gratitude and exhaling gratitude until you can
have gratitude for the very breath that you’re inhaling the very breath that you are
exhaling because without that breath nothing else in your life is possible. The whole
opportunity of life goes away with that breath and a whole new opportunity for life shows
up again in the next moment with each inhale.

Then be grateful for each exhale and grateful for each inhale and keep your attention
down in your body, feel yourself in your lungs, down in your belly. Now I want you to use
your imagination. I want you to imagine that it’s one year, two year, three whatever
amount of time, somewhere in the future and I want you to imagine that everything on
your list of what you want is present in your life. That you’re living the life that you
dreamed possible. That around you are the relationships that you aspire to have. That
you’re interacting with people with love and respect and they’re treating you in a way that
you aspired to be treated. A relationship that you enjoy and love. That you’re living in a
place that you love. That you’re doing work that you love. That you have time to play and
have fun and travel and I want you to imagine that you are there and it’s already
happened and send your gratitude out to your life, for everything in your life.

Go back and review, looking back at all the things that you did to make that life possible.
Go back and look at all the actions you took, all the little steps you took and all the little
results you got along the way to create the whole picture. Imagine having taken all those
steps and seeing the results and being grateful for every action you took and the result you
got and be grateful even if you took an action and it didn’t come out like you expected and
you had to try another one that got you closer and try another one that got you closer.

Be grateful for all this time you took an action that you didn’t get what you wanted
because you learnt from it and refine the action you took. Then be grateful for how you
grew in awareness, how you grew in awareness and mastery and the persistence to keep
taking action, serving people in a way that benefited them and benefited you. Review
everything that happened, everything that worked and everything that didn’t work, all the
actions you took, one’s that worked and one’s that didn’t work and the new actions that
allowed you process to create the life you have. Then you’re looking at every action you
took with gratitude, every result you got with gratitude.





                                                                                                               4/9

As you dream and imagine in this way with this emotional gratitude, what you’re doing is
you’re creating the belief that living in this way is possible. It is not necessarily the belief
in this world, this dream of a new life that will make it happen. It is really because you
believe in it, you will go take the action to create it. Believing in it is not enough, believing
in it will give you the faith that it’s possible and the faith that it’s possible along with the
desire will inspire you to take action and action is what will create it in this state of
believing this world’s way of living, dream of your life is possible.

You will feel confident in taking action, you will have an attitude that is without doubt,
without fear or failure which makes it a lot easier to get up in the morning and go do the
next thing on your list when you’re in a state of gratitude, which is also a state of faith for
what you’re creating. Your gratitude for something that’s not yet created is an indication
of your faith in this possibility which will feed your confidence and inspire you and allow
you to take action without hesitation, resistance, fear or doubt. It puts you in a state of
action. This state that you may have attained or work to attain, this may be a good time to
stop the tape, practice that sense of gratitude, seeing the dream already created, feeling
your faith that you can do it and that it will happen and nurturing that whole state of
confidence and gratitude where you’re suspending all doubt and fear in that state.

Nurture that state for 20, 30 minutes, do it periodically. Do it while you’re working on
your action list. When you’re in that state it’s easy to pick up the phone, make the call, get
in the car, go run the errand you need to do to go make things happen. You don’t really
have to think. You look at your list and then boom you get up in the car and you go do the
thing. That is it. Boom you take on energy and you going to action. I went through this
very quickly. May be it will be good to practice that and come back and listen to the rest of
this tape at a later time. That is one exercise. Gratitude about what you’re creating, if you
see it already done, will help you have the faith.

If you’ve seen the movie Harry Potter, in one of them he’s battling the dementors and
there is a scene at the end where all these dementors are coming for him. He thought his
father had come to get him and saved him and his father cast a great spell and got rid of
the dementors but he’s done this little time-lapse thing, when he went back in time he was
the one that cast the spell. It is a very powerful spell, Expecto Patronum and he
vanquished all the dementors and Hermione asked to wow that was very powerful, how
did you do that? And he said it was easy. I knew I could do it because I’d already done it or
words to that effect. He had already seen it done which helped him have the faith, the
confidence and that faith is what gave him the power to do it. He had no fear, no doubt
because he knew he had already done it.

Anyways it’s a nice storybook example of what I’m talking about in terms of faith to take
action. Believing something by itself is not very powerful and will not manifest or
anything but it will inspire you to take action and that is a much more powerful force of
creation. So that’s what I’ll call a dreamer’s way where you use the imagination, you shift
into a point of view of future, you see it already done. Then there’s the 25:04 point of
view, a stalker’s version. A stalker doesn’t necessarily see it done, a stalker just sees the





                                                                                                               5/9

step in front of them and takes action. It doesn’t really have the picture that the dreamer
have so you may find one of these more practical or useful than the other depending on
your affinity but if you combine them both and you can speed things up.

So the stalkers way about accessing willpower to take action is more body centered, much
more physical listen to mind, more on the feeling. So how I want you to access the state is
let’s start by standing. You can do it sitting if you have to although it’s going to be harder
to notice. Accessing this state is something I first learned to do in martial arts, principally
aikido but you’ll find a lot of it is in tai chi and things like that as well. Then put your feet
apart a little more the shoulder width. Now I want you to bend your knees. Bending your
knee starts to put your attention in your body and you are going to start to feel your body
a lot more. Your will is an energy center. Physically is your center of gravity. The different
martial arts we call it one point. Think of it as an energy center. If you can imagine all the
life force entering into your body at a point just below your bellybutton, couple of inches
below your bellybutton, down in your pelvis.

For women you can use a reference of your womb, place of creation, knees bent and
breath into that energy center, breath into and just feel that area, little side to side,
keeping your whole upper body vertical, not leaning. Keep it vertical and shift your weight
left to right on your feet. What you’ll notice is your whole upper body moves because it’s
directed from that will area. Wherever your pelvis area moves your upper body sits on top
of it. Your upper body follows your will. If you can imagine energy moving up from your
will, into your upper body. The way I will like to imagine it is a giant channel of life
moving into my back, right about the base of my back, into my pelvis and from there that
channel of life then extending down through my legs, up to my torso out of my arms and
into my head.

Then by continuing to rock back and forth with your upper body sitting on top of the
pelvis what then happens is you can start to feel that your pelvis is leading your upper
body. If you also imagine that that life force going down your legs, that life force is what’s
moving your legs that’s allowing your body to shift the left to right. One thing that may
help is if you tuck your pelvis slightly forward, drop your shoulders, relax your arms if you
start to then move pick up your left and right foot. Balance on one foot. With your
attention on the center of your body, when I say center I am talking your one point will,
that energy center that everything is moving around that center. Your legs move from that
center, your torso, your arms move from that center. Breath into the will, breathe into
that center, feel that whole channel of life coming into that center and feel life and energy
radiating from there.

Perhaps you don’t feel it at all as you imagined it, that may come up more and more over
time. Just having your attention that will help. When your legs extend they extend from
that center. Your upper body extends and is balanced on that center. Notice that, that
center your will is the strongest point in your body. If somebody were to try to move you,
they can move an arm, they can grab hold of a leg but if they grab hold of your center they
are going to have a much harder time to move you. If they push you on a shoulder they





                                                                                                               6/9

can tip you over but if they try and grab your center if you just drop down lower you can
drop into a very strong stance knees bent, legs apart they will have a very difficult time
knocking you off balance.

If you have someone to work with or listen to have them push you in different parts of
your body and then have them push you on your hips and you’ll notice that you can hold
yourself very solidly. That will give you a better feeling of what it is to be centered, to be
connected to your will and to start moving from there. There’s more I teach in workshops,
at times how to play with this, but for now this is what we can do.

Now as you really feel that center of energy, walk across the room, but walk across the
room with your awareness and perception in that will. With the awareness that your legs
are just an extension of your will. Your will is driving and leading the movement. There’s
that channel of life coming through, into your body and the follow-on to that is that your
arms and legs and body moves. Your will leads all movement, your will leads all action.
Something you may notice as you walk, it can start to feel kind of powerful even if you just
walk slow and determined.

Breath into that will and as you breathe into the will expand that area, make it bigger.
Inhale and make it bigger. As you let that energy center expand, your movements become
stronger and more confident. You start to walk with a force of intent, moving from your
will, walking across the room in a very determined state, letting everything be centered
from your will, you’ll notice that the mind can become quiet, similar to the last exercise in
the first program where we shifted our eyes. This is shifting your energy center also so you
can walk quietly, with power, with confidence. Take action of walking, take action of
moving while you’re standing so you just rock your weight back and forth.

Now once you’re in this state direct that willful energy up through your body to go do
something on your list, to go pick one of your action items. Say I’m going to do this now
and you can do it much more easily without doubt, without a lot of contemplation, wishy-
washiness in the mind that doesn’t actually get anything done. When you access will,
action becomes easy. There isn’t a right or wrong assessment to be made, a should or
shouldn’t assessment, you just go do something. It’s a subtle energy to capture. Some
people get a hold of it a little easier than others but once you start to feel that energy, you
start to take action that is led or inspired, expressed from the will instead of an action
that’s originating in the mind.

So what we are really doing is we are directing that will of life and action, up through our
energy of our body our core, using the tool of the mind to tell us where to direct that
power but we are not using mind power we are using willpower. This is a whole different
ballgame. When I used to go to the gym and work out, I did a lot of work with exercising
my will. As I was running on the treadmill I’d be running along and I’ll be breathing into
my will and I was willing myself to run. This helped get me out of my head and put me in
a much more natural rhythm of my body, maybe much more present with my body, put
my breath and my will together. Inhaling into my will and would make my will strong,
expanding that energy center.




                                                                                                               7/9

Same thing if I was lifting weights, going for a bike ride, I would do it as an act of will.
Being present with my body noticing that I am moving life to that body and its expressing
itself in a runner or a bike ride or lifting weights and the expression is coming in through
my physical body at that point of my will and going out through my muscles. My body’s
expressing life. I don’t have to engage in a lot of mental chatter about it, becomes more of
an energetic and physical experience. That’s what taking action is. So putting yourself in
that state can quiet the mind which helps eliminate the doubt, fears, eliminates the
hesitations and now you’re in a much more confident state, a much stronger attitude to go
take action and say thy will be done, thy will be done.

As you practice each of these techniques, one’s a very bodily oriented exercise, one’s a very
imagination, and dreaming and motion oriented exercise. As you practice the two of
these, you can then start combining the two. You start accessing your will, feeling that
force of life in you, directing it up through your body and seeing what you want to create
and then infusing it with gratitude and now you’re adding a lot more horsepower. You can
put a lot more power into that dream as you create it with gratitude.

Something I want to share, this may relate somewhat to what people talk about in this law
of attraction in secret movie. I’ve read about love attraction, at this point I haven’t seen
the movie the secret. There is some validity to that whole love attraction thing. There is
validity in that we can’t consciously create, what I will say is we do not consciously create
our reality, we very much create either consciously or unconsciously our virtual reality
and we can consciously, although most people do it unconsciously create our actions and
our expressions. My experience is that the law of attraction is not a law. It doesn’t work
like gravity and that it doesn’t work all the time everywhere. There are still other forces in
life. They talk about the law of attraction as if it’s the only law. It’s not, there are other
forces of life. There are skills to be applied and expertise to be applied. Just because you
dream something up and you believe in it doesn’t mean it’s going to happen because you
dream something up, you believe in it and you take action. Now it’s more possible.

If you dream something up and you believe in it you take action and you take skillful
action. Now you even have a better probability but if you take skillful action in the wrong
environment it’s not necessarily going to work. If you decide that you want to become a
millionaire and so you start buying real estate property, that can be great but if it’s not
skillful action you might buy real estate property at the top of a boom and now the prices
go down and you lose money. You believed in it, you believed in yourself, you took the
action, you had faith. It doesn’t mean it’s going to manifest because there are other forces
in the world that are affecting the real estate market. Then the more skillful action, the
better is your timing to buy, the better is your capacity to negotiate the price, the better is
your opportunity to profit and become wealthy.

Then the more skillful you are, the more adept you will be at managing your life, your
money and creating wealth in consideration of these other forces like the market. So it is
not a law, it is not a law. It is an opportunity to influence, to create, the more you practice
and access your willpower the greater is your faith, the more influence you will have to
affect the world around you. But you’re not the only force on the planet. So the world
doesn’t bend to an individual’s will. The only time that that’s possible is when that person


                                                                                                               8/9

really merges themselves with the will of life. When they make their will so big, they make
their faith so strong that they connect to that channel of life that they become the will of
life and then their personal will is the divine will. Then there is the opportunity to create
miracles.

However the interesting thing about that state is that when you’re in that state there is
usually not a whole lot to create. You no longer have your personal desires. They are not
that important, they are not important at all. So you don’t create in a world, in a direction
of your own personal desires. If someone’s achieving that state of consciousness, creating
something for themselves is not that big a deal. There is not really a desire to do it. No, at
that point you operate much more in a direction of serving life. At that point you are not
so much serving yourself. It’s kind of irony, at the point that your consciousness expands
and you can access the power to create anything for yourself, you lose the desire to create
for the individual self because your consciousness is expanded to create for much larger
self, one that includes all creation, your brothers and sisters, people around you, people
you love, people who you find are part of your own larger being.

Oddly enough, one of the ways that you get to expand to this level of consciousness is by
exercising your personal willpower, exercising your faith through gratitude and your love
by building a more beautiful and beautiful personal dream, by creating through action
and practicing exercising your will through action you are accessing more and more the
will of life and you’re creating a more and more beautiful personal dream for yourself. At
the same time you’re opening that channel of connection to life.

As that channel connection opens, as you see the world with more and more gratitude,
which is with more and more faith, your consciousness expands, you are opening to that
channel of life until you merge with life. These two exercises are doorways to that
experience so that as you use these to exercise, to build a more beautiful dream for
yourself, to create your own personal dream of heaven you’re expanding your
consciousness to experience a greater heaven.

There’s no need to think of it as selfish and cause you to hesitate because it can take you
farther than something personal. Use it as a bridge, these doorways to realizing a greater
sense of self. Enjoy the tools, enjoy creating because it’s what you do. The creator is what
you are, creating is what you do. Have fun. Enjoy your journey. This has been about
desire, action through willpower and faith to create what you want. This is Gary van
Warmerdam in the self-mastery series, a pathway to happiness.com. Thank you very
much.

                                                                                                                     April 15, 2015

How To Create Wealth

How Do You Create Wealth

First take time to notice the abundance in your life.

How much is your eyesight worth?
How much is your hearing worth?
How much is the ability to breath and walk worth?
How much are friends and family that support you worth to you?

Then you will have gratitude.

At this point, you might realize that you have all the wealth you need, and more.

With gratitude it will be easier to see what is possible.

With Gratitude you can marvel with wonder at what is possible.
With these eyes of wonder you will be able to see and dream new possibilities.
With a sense of possibility you will have excitement and inspiration.

If you don’t feel these things, then perhaps fear is in the way of gratitude and possibility.
Then you must identify fear and change the false beliefs fear arises from.
When we feel fear, or have limiting beliefs of fear, these emotions and beliefs determine
what we see.

With fear we see a world with scarcity, competition, and adversaries.

With gratitude we see the people that will support our dreams and efforts.

When you feel gratitude you will see the world differently and will have faith in a greater
possibility.

With Faith in what is possible you will be inclined to take action.

When you take a new action, you will get a new result.

Then you measure the result and adjust your next action for a better result.

Then you get better and better at getting results.

And then, many times in this process, ask your self if you will trade what you are doing,
and what you are gaining for your happiness? Many people often go after wealth and
success without asking this question, and decades later regret the happiness the




                                                                                                               1/2

sacrificed. It takes them many years to realize that their emotional state of happiness was
devalued, when in fact it was worth more all along. It is the person that is happy that often
has a precious joy that he will not trade for material riches.

If you have dominion over your attention, and emotions, they you can live in peaceful
happiness. Such a person is already wealthy. They have a kind of wealth that people with
money can not afford .

Seeking Unconditional Love

   pathwaytohappiness.com/blog/unconditional-love

                                                                                         August 1, 2018

The Spiritual Journey is for you if you are serious about increasing the amount love and
happiness in your lives.

Coming to the Spiritual Retreat in Mexico is like coming home to a place you belong.
The unconditional acceptance and love is a warm welcoming that keeps giving long after
you leave. It isn’t just the consciousness opening experience of what was once a great
Spiritual University, but it is the heart opening experiences with others as well.


How could traveling to a foreign country and walking around ancient ruins make you feel
at home? “Home” is a feeling. It is a feeling of being completely accepted just the way you
are. Through various contemplative meditations and ceremonies, you work your way into
a state of consciousness where the voice of the inner critic doesn’t exist. You also grow a
feeling of love and acceptance with others that allows you to drop the worries about what
others think of you.


Nobody cares about what you have done in your life, or what you haven’t done. We don’t
care about what happened to you in the past as it doesn’t determine your value or worth.
We only care that you leave it behind in a process of letting go so you can be present with
who you are now. We care about whether you are happy, feeling love, and self-acceptance.
And we care about doing things that purge out the fear, false beliefs, and judgments that
interfere with an internal state of happiness.


I noticed that when I left home and went to college that there were many groups that I
could join. There was a catch though, I could belong if I believed what they believed. I had
to do the things they did. To be a part of a community I had to give up my identity, the
right and ability to think and freely choose. I had to accept their value system,
interpretations, and perspective, and then they would accept me and be my friend. It was
on a Spiritual Journey such as the one to Teotihuacan that I discovered that I could be
accepting of myself just the way I was, and that I could accept others just the way they
were as well.


I have taken that feeling from those journeys and brought it inward and grown it. I’ve
since come to feel I belong in the world without having to subjugate myself to someone
else’s opinions. You get to be you, and you have every right to feel you belong in this world
just the way you are. It is this sense of peace and calm in oneself that we all seek, and
when we find it we feel we are home. This is the feeling inside of you that the Spiritual





                                                                                                               1/2

Journey to Teotihuacan brings out in you. You all have it inside you, just buried in various
layers of fog. In these Journeys we have ways of uncovering that fog and bring out the
Unconditional Love.



When you create or find, that sense of peace within yourself you no longer worry about
finding the right person. You no longer worry about losing the partner you have and being
alone. You have a sense of peace and calm with yourself that allows you to be happy with
you. In the ceremonies in Teotihuacan we shed the beliefs and fears that interfere with
feeling peaceful self-acceptance.


We do a lot of hard work clearing away our false beliefs, emotional reactions, negative
thinking, and sabotaging behaviors. We have a strong intent, and a good track record that
you will be a changed person when you board the airplane headed back home. It’s just
that we aren’t hard on ourselves as we do it. A compassionate accepting environment
allows us to get it all done, gently, and fast. We also balance out the hard work with
bountiful amounts of tasty and healthy food, friendship, laughter, and play.


Consider taking a Journey inward and finding the Love that makes you feel at home with
yourself.
